texts.preamble: M/S Raj General Store vs State Of Telangana on 9 December, 2024 Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy Writ Petition No.34464 Of 2024 Order :
texts.facts: (ORAL) This writ petition is filed seeking to declare the action of respondent No.6 - the Sub-Inspector of Police, Asifabad Police Station, in interfering with the business activity of the petitioner run under the name and style of 'M/s Raj General Store', No.193, Asifabad main road, near Apollo Medical, Komuram Bheem Asifabad District, as being illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional. Respondent No.6 neither called the petitioner to the Police Station nor harassed him as alleged in the writ affidavit.
texts.arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the products being sold by the petitioner in his shop do not contain tobacco and nicotine and they are not banned products under the provisions of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 and the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and rule made there under. Despite the same, there is interference by respondent No.6 with the business activity of the petitioner. Learned Assistant Government Pleader submitted that there is no interference by respondent No.6 with the business activity of the petitioner in any manner.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the products being sold by the petitioner in his shop do not contain tobacco and nicotine and they are not banned products under the provisions of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 and the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and rule made there under. Despite the same, there is interference by respondent No.6 with the business activity of the petitioner.
texts.respondent_arguments: Learned Assistant Government Pleader submitted that there is no interference by respondent No.6 with the business activity of the petitioner in any manner.
